mapper.sql: doc_id AS docId, title, kb_version AS kbVersion, status, authority_level AS authorityLevel, url, effective_from AS effectiveFrom, effective_to AS effectiveTo, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO report_kb_document (doc_id, title, kb_version, status, authority_level, url, effective_from, effective_to, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{docId}, #{title}, #{kbVersion}, #{status}, #{authorityLevel}, #{url}, #{effectiveFrom}, #{effectiveTo}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3))
mapper.update: UPDATE report_kb_document SET title = #{title}, kb_version = #{kbVersion}, status = #{status}, authority_level = #{authorityLevel}, url = #{url}, effective_from = #{effectiveFrom}, effective_to = #{effectiveTo}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE doc_id = #{docId}
mapper.select: SELECT MAX(kb_version) FROM report_kb_document WHERE status = 'PUBLISHED' AND effective_from <= #{now} AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to > #{now})
